title: Sky scientists
info: Copernicus argued that Earth moves around the Sun.
Galileo used a telescope and saw moons orbiting Jupiter and phases of Venus. Those clues did not fit Earth sitting still at the center.
Newton showed that the same gravity explains falling apples and orbiting planets.
Later, Edwin Hubble showed that many fuzzy patches are galaxies beyond the Milky Way.
